methods.m2: reviewer_b linear mean + residual GP + sigma conformal

config.s0: round2 non-ideal E-in 150, identical initial training set for every arm of every pair

seeds.H: int(first 8 hex chars of the prereg commit SHA, 16)

held_out.T5: LHS(d=4, seed=rng) 300 pts on full domain, dead_time 6 categories {0..2.5}; drop corner (load<=.35 & bw<=75); first 60
held_out.C5: LHS 40: load [.30,.35], bw 50*1.5**u kHz, dead_time 6 categories, aperture [0,30]
held_out.D5: LHS 40: dead_time 3.0, other three dims full range

active_arm.rule: round3 sigma believer (scripts/dclink_active3.py), 5 batches x 22, pool round3 pool.json excluding own picks

mixed_arm.rule: round4 sigma/sqrt(1+a_c) believer (scripts/dclink_active4.py), a_c counts own picks incl. in-batch, 5 x 22

config.adaptive_index: A_k: 800+220(k-1)+j ; M_k: 910+220(k-1)+j, j=0..109 in selection order
config.per_arm_metric: mean Winkler (alpha=0.1) of M2 intervals on C5 (40) [H1-H3] or D5 (40) [H4]
config.test: exact one-sided sign-flip permutation test over K=6 pair differences d_k; p = #{s in {+-1}^6: mean(s*d) >= mean(d)}/64 (ties count, identity included)
config.multiplicity: fixed-sequence H1 -> H2 -> H3 -> H4, each at alpha=0.05; stop at first non-rejection (later ones reported as not tested, nominal p report-only); FWER <= 0.05

coverage.per_arm: C1 T5 >=48/60; C2-corner C5 >=32/40 and mean width <= 3x T5 width; C2-dt3 D5 >=32/40 and width <= 3x T5 width
coverage.CV: method X in {A,M,R}: at least 5 of 6 arms pass all three per-arm criteria

execution.order: held-out + R arms, then A/M arms batch-synchronously b=1..5 across all 12 adaptive arms
execution.memory_watchdog: SIGSTOP below ~3.8 GiB available, SIGCONT above ~4.3 GiB

inference: K=6 paired; conditional on S0; fixed H1→H2→H3→H4; old sets and M0/M1 report only
